What United States Antimony says to expect

  • Full year 2026: antimony sales volumeFor full-year 2026, the Company expects to sell approximately 1.68 million to 1.81 million pounds of antimony, compared with approximately 1.41 million pounds in 2025, an increase of approximately 24% at the midpoint.
